hq.fitViewLabel: Reset view: center, 100% zoom and default camera
hq.hologramLabel: Shielded Company Brain orb above its base
hq.sceneUnavailableLabel: 3D rendering is unavailable in this browser. Enable hardware acceleration to show the hologram.
hq.mouseControlsLabel: Left drag rotates. Middle drag moves across the map. Scroll zooms with side panels closed. Right click is inactive.
